summary: First-party English and Chinese discovery found Sanmenxia municipal government and the local real-estate registration and transaction center/procedure. No public cadastral parcel viewer or safe anonymous parcel ID+geometry response was verified.
queryOutcomes: Both first-party discovery queries are recorded in the city record. English search identified the municipal portal and registration center. Chinese search for 三门峡 不动产登记 地籍图 宗地图 地图服务 identified official registration/procedure material but no open parcel service.
requestOutcomes: Anonymous TLS-verified GET requests: https://www.smx.gov.cn/ returned HTTP 200; https://www.smx.gov.cn/28072/615992832/965200.html returned HTTP 200; https://www.smx.gov.cn/4036/2026/6/2271764.html was used as official local-center evidence; https://xy.smx.gov.cn/wcm/content/detail/20250430085514_100046.html returned HTTP 403. The official homepage HTML was inspected for map/viewer/API references; its map asset is an administrative image and no parcel endpoint was exposed. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS-disable exception was used.
scopeLimits: No current open Sanmenxia parcel coverage, viewer, or feature service verified
No parcel schema, CRS, native identity, or geometry response obtained
No exact-point parcel inference made; zero geometry is not evidence of citywide absence
Official registration procedure evidence is distinguished from a public cadastral map/API
No request for owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, or other unsafe fields
safeFieldAllowlist: native parcel ID if publicly exposed
uncertainty: The city may have an internal, authenticated, interactive, unpublished, or otherwise non-indexed cadastral system. The 403 response and absence of a public endpoint are route-specific limitations, not evidence that parcels do not exist citywide. No coordinate shift was attempted.

runtimeQualification.reason: No independently qualified real Sanmenxia adapter or verified open parcel geometry/native-ID response.
